prior_importants.description: The fresh-base refusal tells the reader to run `git rebase --abort` (and `git merge --abort`, `git cherry-pick --abort`) in the worktree. `pup merge` and `pup review` also print that detail to the conductor or operator, who run git unsandboxed. An abort over a planted `rebase-merge/` there moves the ref `head-name` names, `main` included, to the planted `orig-head`. This is the hazard 5718a94 fixed in the land message.

findings.description: The fresh-base detail "Auto-rebase failed and so did its abort" still tells every reader to run `git rebase --abort` in the worktree. That is the advice this PR removed from the in-progress-state message. The same report reaches `pup merge`/`pup review` operators and humans handed a blocked session, all outside the sandbox. Their abort runs over rebase state the live session can write (decision 120), so it can move any branch, main included.

process_issues.description: Incremental round 3 over a 3-file, 21-line delta. Context and maintainability were not spawned because their gates did not hold. Spec did not run (no closing issue), nor workflow-safety (no workflow change), nor simplicity (the delta adds no file, helper, option or branch). The consolidator was skipped because only one finding came back.
